items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Kenny Burrell, Lionel Hampton and there were a bunch of people. J.R. was on that. Yeah. I’ve been kind of fortunate in the people I’ve played with.

ctx.x: Was that a road gig? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -22-

That was a jazz festival down in the Poconos somewhere. Kenny Burrell, Lionel Hampton and there were a bunch of people. J.R. was on that. Yeah. I’ve been kind of fortunate in the people I’ve played with.

I know you’ve mentioned one thing that I think you very much like is when a horn player or a singer has their own sense of time. You used to tell me to listen to Dolores [Mancuso] how she, and Sal Amico too.
